_comment: TASK-015. Named exceptions of the two vendor-mail guards. `separation` entries are PAIRS: an allowance is stale -- and fails the guard -- the moment either side of its pair is gone, never on a date (Q2). `principals.vendorRealms` are structural (the realms that ARE the vendor's) and hold under --no-allowances; `principals.transitional` entries are dropped by --no-allowances (TASK-038's host run). The `separation` list is empty since PLAN-mail-transport M4 retired the app tier's PLATFORM_SMTP_PASSWORD (platform-smtp-transitional): an entry whose pair is gone fails the guard until it is deleted.

vendorRealms.master: the operator realm every Keycloak has; sends as system@ (realm-smtp)
vendorRealms.platform: reserved for spec C's operator realm (mail.env.tmpl KEYCLOAK_PROBE_REALM comment); gets system@ through realm-smtp (TASK-043 Q5)

transitional.why: customer realms may still send as platform@ until TASK-043 issues their kc-<token>@. It waives only the SHARING of platform@ by customer realms; a realm whose From is not platform@ (realm-doc.ts stamps no-reply@) still fails, because the pinned build refuses that envelope (501 5.5.4, measured)
